subject: vela.claim-record.v1 relations[].kind
not_this_field: `evidence[].relation` is a different axis: it names the role an Artifact plays for one Claim, never a link between two Claims. Every retained Claim Record spells it `supports`. Nothing here applies to it.
note: Two declared semantic classes over one field. The correction algebra is closed and authoritative: acceptance acts on it and Standing moves. Descriptive relations are retained context that no Decision reads. Every well-formed spelling is matched exactly as stored; an unknown name remains unrecognized description and is never rewritten into a declared kind.

descriptive_relations.enumerated_from: the frozen 2026-08-06 four-repository census, not from intent

census.note: Frozen historical observation, not a live census this fixture verifies. The four topic repositories are archived; the checker verifies only that every retained kind in this 2026-08-06 census remains classified and parseable.
census.separation: Every `supersedes` sits on a revision-2 Claim whose sole provenance is a `submission`. Every descriptive relation sits on a revision-1 Claim retained before the correction path. No correction relation was imported, and no descriptive relation appears on a revised Claim.

never_written.note: Spellings PROTOCOL.md declared through 0.966.3 that no repository has ever recorded. All four are withdrawn: if retained as a well-formed Claim relation they are exact unrecognized description, never aliases. `depends_on` remains only a derived correction-impact rule kind; retraction moves Standing through the `claim.withdraw` Proposal action and needs no relation.
